fusions.name: Dead Stop
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles, leaves it [Bruised] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 40% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck Breastplate
fusions.desc: Rings your breastplate in a blow that deals 7 resonating damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Also costs 3% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Plates at Rest
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Mossback Harness
fusions.desc: Equips armour that lowers every hit you take by 2, raises your armour by 10% and raises your maximum health by 12.
